=== FILE: counter.v ===
// A 4-bit counter that wraps at LIMIT. The M21 fixture for real EDA runs.
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
module counter #(
    parameter [3:0] LIMIT = 4'd9
) (
    input  wire       clk,
    input  wire       rst,
    input  wire       en,
    output reg  [3:0] count,
    output wire       wrap
);
    assign wrap = en && (count == LIMIT);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst)
            count <= 4'd0;
        else if (wrap)
            count <= 4'd0;
        else if (en)
            count <= count + 5'd1;
    end

`ifdef FORMAL
    // Once reset has been applied, the count never passes LIMIT.
    reg seen_reset = 1'b0;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst)
            seen_reset <= 1'b1;
        if (seen_reset)
            assert (count <= LIMIT);
    end

    // Cover (M27): the count reaches LIMIT and wraps, so the assertion above
    // is checked on a run that actually counts.
    always @(posedge clk)
        if (seen_reset && !rst)
            cover (wrap);
`endif
endmodule
=== END FILE ===
- Content of refused file counter_tb.v (sha256:ee514f3dd04e603d67b0325a66b2977de03a7c3c6bee2e84e631f3d6ed086105):
=== FILE: counter_tb.v ===
// Self-checking testbench for counter.v: counts to LIMIT, wraps, and finishes.
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
module counter_tb;
    reg clk = 1'b0;
    reg rst = 1'b1;
    reg en = 1'b0;
    wire [3:0] count;
    wire wrap;
    integer errors = 0;
    integer i;

    counter #(.LIMIT(4'd9)) dut (.clk(clk), .rst(rst), .en(en), .count(count), .wrap(wrap));

    always #5 clk = ~clk;

    initial begin
        @(negedge clk);
        rst = 1'b0;
        en = 1'b1;
        for (i = 1; i <= 12; i = i + 1) begin
            @(negedge clk);
            if (count !== i % 10) begin
                $display("ERROR: cycle %0d: count is %0d, expected %0d", i, count, i % 10);
                errors = errors + 1;
            end
        end
        if (errors == 0)
            $display("counter_tb: PASS");
        $finish;
    end
endmodule
=== END FILE ===
